name: tier-list-studio
description: Local-first desktop app for creating polished tier lists.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: tsc --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop --types node --outDir dist --rootDir src src/main/index.ts src/preload/index.ts
